about: BREVITY, the proword selection loop (BOLO 37, ruled 9/23). One slot per word the Command still needs. slots.thing: The command proword for 'this is the one thing, focus here': MCDP 1's designated main effort, the task everything else supports. Spoken, it names or asks for the single priority. Block VI's title rides on it.

The boresight aimed outside the wire: the same three-part read (readback, the read, clarifying questions) drawing on the web and the literature instead of the vault. Chief: 'a word different than boresight for anything on the web or outside of it.'
The modifier for a back-of-the-napkin read: a fast, rough pass that says the shape of the answer before the real read. Chief: 'I want to be able to say napkin boresight.'
The noun for what an outside read brings back: the product, not the pass. Chief's pooled seed INTEL sits here unassigned.
BVX intake step one: pull the tier-one 101 texts of a field, one per field, ivory tower ('the Oxford whatever of whatever'). BOLO 36.
BVX intake step three: the book goes through the Zotero pipeline and comes out as a one-sheet, MCDP-style. BOLO 36.
BVX intake step four: derive how the system's language operates, the tool's grammar or coding language, from the two theories. BOLO 36.
The agent-ceiling scale: gear 1 = 3 agents, doubling upward. Chief: 'like gears on a transmission... let's just call them gears for now.' The system's name, the gearbox, rides on it.
